|lore=C-3PO was Jabba’s “khan chita,” or translator. Survived more battles than most members of the Alliance. Wasn’t informed of R2-D2’s role in the rescue of Han.<ref name="foil-face" />
|game_text=Deploys only to a Jabba’s Palace site. Once per game, when replacing another C-3PO, retrieve 3 Force. When in battle with your other droid and a Rebel, adds one battle destiny. R2-D2 deploys and moves for free to this location.<ref name="foil-face" />
